info.title: Techzu Support API
info.description: Support Ticket & SLA Management API. Get a Sanctum bearer token from `POST /api/v1/auth/tokens` with `email`, `password` and `device_name`, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors are `{"message", "code"}`; branch on `code` or the HTTP status.
